title: ProjGradedModuleChartPrincipalLocalization
statement: Let $S$ be an $\mathbb N$-graded commutative ring with grading $\mathcal A$, let $M$ be an $S$-module, and set $X=\operatorname{Proj}(S)$ [def-nagata-affine-proj]. Index charts by pairs $f=(a,d)$ with $d>0$ and $a\in S_d$. Put $D_f=D_+(a)$, $R_f=S_{(a)}$ [def-nagata-homogeneous-localization-degree-zero], $N_f=M_a$, and let $Z_f\subseteq N_f$ be $R_f$-submodules, where the scalar action on $N_f$ is restricted from $S_a$. For each inclusion $D_g\subseteq D_f$, suppose ring maps $\rho^S_{f,g}:R_f\to R_g$ and additive maps $\rho_{f,g}:Z_f\to Z_g$ are given. Let $U_{f,g}\in R_f$ have image $g^{\deg f}/f^{\deg g}$ in $S_f$. Suppose additive equivalences $\theta_{f,g}:(Z_f)_{U_{f,g}}\cong Z_g$ and ring equivalences $\theta^S_{f,g}:(R_f)_{U_{f,g}}\cong R_g$ are given for all these inclusions, with $\theta_{f,g}(q/1)=\rho_{f,g}(q)$, $\theta^S_{f,g}(r/1)=\rho^S_{f,g}(r)$ and $\theta_{f,g}(tq)=\theta^S_{f,g}(t)\theta_{f,g}(q)$. Assume every $\rho^S_{f,g}$ is induced by an $S$-algebra map $S_f\to S_g$. Let $F$ be an $\mathcal O_X$-module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with additive equivalences $\alpha_f:F(D_f)\cong Z_f$, compatible with scalar multiplication via awayToSection and with restriction via $\rho$. Fix a chart $f$, write $e:D_f\cong\operatorname{Spec}R_f$ for its canonical affine isomorphism and $E=F|_{D_f}$. There is an additive equivalence $b:E(D_f)\cong Z_f$ such that, for every $r\in R_f$ and $V=e^{-1}D(r)$, and every ring equivalence $t:\mathcal O_{D_f}(V)\cong(R_f)_r$ sending the pulled-back constant $x$ to $x/1$, there is an additive equivalence $c:E(V)\cong(Z_f)_r$. It satisfies $c(xs)=t(x)c(s)$ for all section-ring scalars and $c(s|_V)=b(s)/1$ for all whole-chart sections. No tilde comparison or compatibility between proper opens is asserted.

proof.text: Construct b explicitly from restrictAppIso, transport along the terminal-image equality, and alpha_f. Use basicOpenToSpec_app_top, scalar naturality of restriction, and hscalar to make the canonical restriction map l R_f-linear.
Apply the restriction localization universal property to l. Construct c as the inverse of IsLocalizedModule.iso, and prove restriction normalization by iso_symm_apply.

Equip the section ring with its chart R_f-algebra structure. The prescribed ring equivalence t is an R_f-algebra equivalence by its constant normalization, hence the section ring is a localization at powers of r. Give the target localized module its section-ring action via t. The inverse localization comparison is R_f-linear; linearMap_compatibleSMul extends its linearity to the section ring, proving the scalar formula.

theorem gradedModuleChart_principalLocalization
    (Z : ∀ f : Fidx, Submodule R[f] N[f])
    (rhoS : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] → R[f] →+* R[g])
    (rho : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] → Z f →+ Z g)
    (U : ∀ (f g : Fidx), R[f])
    (hU : ∀ (f g : Fidx), (U f g).val = Localization.mk (g.val.1 ^ f.val.2)
      (⟨f.val.1 ^ g.val.2, ⟨g.val.2, rfl⟩⟩ : Submonoid.powers f.val.1))
    (theta : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] →
      LocalizedModule.Away (U f g) (Z f) ≃+ Z g)
    (thetaS : ∀ (f g : Fidx), D[g] ≤ D[f] → Localization.Away (U f g) ≃+* R[g])
    (htheta : ∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]),
      (∀ r : R[f], thetaS f g i (algebraMap R[f] (Localization.Away (U f g)) r) =
        rhoS f g i r) ∧
      (∀ q : Z f, theta f g i (mk q 1) = rho f g i q) ∧
      (∀ (r : Localization.Away (U f g)) (q : LocalizedModule.Away (U f g) (Z f)),
        theta f g i (r • q) = thetaS f g i r • theta f g i q))
    (hcanonical : ∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f]),
      ∃ l : Localization.Away f.val.1 →+* Localization.Away g.val.1,
        (∀ a : S, l (algebraMap S (Localization.Away f.val.1) a) =
          algebraMap S (Localization.Away g.val.1) a) ∧
        ∀ r : R[f], (rhoS f g i r).val = l r.val)
    (F : ModX) (alpha : ∀ f : Fidx, F.val.obj (op D[f]) ≃+ Z f)
    (hscalar : ∀ (f : Fidx) (r : R[f]) (s : F.val.obj (op D[f])),
      alpha f ((awayToSection 𝒜 f.val.1 r) • s) = r • alpha f s)
    (hrestriction : ∀ (f g : Fidx) (i : D[g] ≤ D[f])
      (s : F.val.obj (op D[f])),
      alpha g (F.val.map (homOfLE i).op s) = rho f g i (alpha f s))
    (f : Fidx) :
      let e := basicOpenIsoSpec 𝒜 f.val.1 f.property.2 f.property.1
      let E := Scheme.Modules.restrict F D[f].ι
      ∃ b : E.val.obj (op ⊤) ≃+ Z f,
        ∀ (r : R[f]),
          let V := e.hom ⁻¹ᵁ PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen r
          ∀ t : D[f].toScheme.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (op V) ≃+* Localization.Away r,
            (∀ x : R[f], t ((e.hom.appLE ⊤ V (by simp))
              ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of R[f])).inv x)) =
                algebraMap R[f] (Localization.Away r) x) →
            ∃ c : E.val.obj (op V) ≃+ LocalizedModule.Away r (Z f),
              (∀ (x : D[f].toScheme.ringCatSheaf.obj.obj (op V))
                (s : E.val.obj (op V)), c (x • s) = t x • c s) ∧
              ∀ s : E.val.obj (op ⊤),
                c (E.val.map V.leTop.op s) = mk (b s) 1
